new_blockers.summary: The production selector canonicalizes offsets with _round_offset(x)=round(float(x),3) and compares to the rounded bank. Verified ACCEPTED (smuggled into the bank): grasp_offset_local_y = +0.0004 (->0.0), numeric string '0.0' (->0.0 via float()), -0.0396 (->-0.04), +0.0404 (->+0.04). NaN raised a raw KeyError (not a clean BestSingleInputError). The identity module already does this correctly (isclose abs_tol=1e-12, reject bool/str/non-finite); the selector does not.
new_blockers.minimal_fix: In the selector, canonicalize each offset like confirmatory_v4_identity._canon_numeric: reject bool and non-(int/float), reject non-finite, and require math.isclose(offset, bank_value, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-12) to a frozen bank value (not round(.,3)); else EXPERIMENT_INVALID_BEST_SINGLE_INPUT.

new_blockers.summary: validate_fully_resolved_phase_manifest checks only phase, required-key PRESENCE, list lengths, and counts. It performs NO semantic validation. Verified: a train_validation manifest with 228 IDENTICAL/duplicate trials, all-'train' blocks (wrong 9-train+6-val composition), and planned_episode_id inconsistent with canonical_trial_identity VALIDATES and yields a 'valid' full hash. This is the exact 5.4 integrity-blocker condition (also subsumes 4.1: the validator does not recompute planned_episode_id from canonical_trial_identity).
new_blockers.minimal_fix: Add (or explicitly freeze as required generator-validator rules): per-phase split composition (train_validation = 9 train + 6 val blocks / 45 train + 12 val sessions; test = 9 test blocks / 18 sessions); block/session/trial uniqueness; 4 trials/session = probe + 3 candidates with the bank; planned_episode_id == planned_episode_id(canonical_trial_identity); referential integrity (each trial's session/block exist); residual shared within a block; nuisance shared within a block; execution_order_index unique/complete/no gaps; resolved_candidate_order is a bank permutation; subseeds recomputed from frozen identity+seed; resume_key == planned_episode_id; planned_structure_sha256 == frozen structure hash; frozen seeds/config/protocol version match; all numerics finite; reject unexpected/stray fields (incl. a nested 'integrity' block). A shape-only hash of a duplicated manifest must not be accepted as a scientific integrity anchor.
